With this setting bids increase when your ad is more likely to convert to a sale, and bids decrease when less likely to convert to a sale. \| \| `MANUAL` \| Fixed bid \| Uses your exact bid and any placement adjustments you set, and is not subject to dynamic bidding. \| \| `RULE_BASED` \| Rule based bidding \| See Rule based bidding documentation https://advertising.amazon.com/API/docs/en-us/sponsored-products/rule-based-bidding/overview \| |
